title: Oracle EBS Database Administrator (DBA)
description:
**This role is eligible for our hybrid work model: 2 days in-office**
Our Technology team is the backbone of our company: constantly creating, testing, learning and iterating to better meet the needs of our customers. If you thrive in a fast-paced, ideas-led environment, you’re in the right place.
  
  
**Why This Job’s a Big Deal**
Join a dynamic, Agile team dedicated to building the future of travel technology. We continuously explore new innovations and engineer solutions to meet evolving business needs.
  
  
We are seeking an Oracle EBS Database Administrator (DBA) with strong expertise in supporting the Oracle E-Business Suite financial modules, including Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), and General Ledger (GL). In this role, you will install, configure, tune, secure, and maintain the Oracle databases and EBS application environments that power our financial operations, ensuring high availability, performance, and reliability. You will work closely with developers, functional teams, and infrastructure partners to support period-end close, troubleshoot issues, and keep systems running smoothly.
  
  
**In This Role You Will Get To**

* Lead the administration, monitoring, and architecture of EBS application tier components including Oracle WebLogic Server, application services, and AutoConfig management, setting standards and best practices for the team.
* Administer and optimize the underlying Oracle Database tier — including backup and recovery (RMAN), space and performance management, parameter tuning, and high-availability configurations (RAC/Data Guard) — ensuring the stability, security, and scalability of EBS databases.
* Own the end-to-end online patching lifecycle using ADOP (prepare, apply, finalize, cutover, cleanup), define the patching strategy, and oversee post-patch validations across environments.
* Plan and lead CPU/RU/PSU patching and version upgrades, including impact assessment, scheduling, and rollback planning.
* Drive application performance optimization including concurrent manager tuning, JVM monitoring, and advanced troubleshooting of application logs, leveraging tools such as AWR, ASH, and ADDM reports to diagnose and resolve complex performance issues.
* Architect and support application integrations, workflow mailer, and interface configurations (bank connectivity), SFTP for inbound and outbound processes, and establish standards for reliability and security.
* Lead application security configurations such as SSL certificates, profile options, and compliance-related activities, and partner with security/audit teams on remediation.
* Define and oversee housekeeping and environment health standards including log/output purging, workflow data cleanup, disk space monitoring, and proactive health checks.
* Own environment cloning (APPS), including automation and standardization of the cloning process.
* Lead release and change management activities including migration of custom objects, SIT/UAT support, and post-deployment validation, acting as a key approver and technical reviewer.
* Mentor and upskill junior DBAs, embedding DB best practices and standards across the team and raising the overall technical bar.
* Partner closely with Product, Development, and Infrastructure teams to plan, coordinate, and implement DB initiatives that drive customer happiness and operational excellence.
* Contribute to long-term EBS platform strategy, including cloud migration readiness (e.g., OCI, Database@Cloud) and modernization initiatives.

**Who You Are**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering/Computer Science/Information Technology, or related industry experience or equivalent training and experience.
* 6+ years of validated work experience as an Oracle EBS Apps DBA, with a proven track record owning production environments.
* Deep expertise in EBS Concurrent Processing, including advanced troubleshooting and tuning.
* Strong command of cloning and patching concepts, strategy, and execution across multiple environments.
* Expert in Linux environments and shell scripting, with the ability to automate routine and complex DBA tasks.
* Able to independently troubleshoot failed concurrent requests, interpret error messages, and resolve root causes.
* Proficient in reading and acting on AWR, ASH, and ADDM reports to drive performance improvements.
* Able to work autonomously, lead by example, and empower the team with best methods and standards.
* A proactive collaborator and mentor who helps others learn, grow, and handle critical DB tasks independently.
* Comfortable providing 24x7 support on P1 issues as part of an On-Call Rotation, and able to lead incident response and root-cause analysis.
* DB and related certifications strongly preferred (e.g., OCP, EBS R12 certifications).
* Demonstrated history of living the values necessary to Priceline: Customer, Innovation, Team, Accountability, and Trust.
* The Right Results, the Right Way is not just a motto at Priceline; it’s a way of life. Unquestionable integrity and ethics is essential.

**Who We Are**
**WE ARE PRICELINE.**
Our success as one of the biggest players in online travel is all thanks to our incredible, dedicated team of talented employees. Priceliners are focused on being the best travel deal makers in the world, motivated by our passion to help everyone experience the moments that matter most in their lives. Whether it’s a dream vacation, your cousin’s graduation, or your best friend’s wedding - we make travel affordable and accessible to our customers.
  
  
Our culture is unique and inspiring (that’s what our employees tell us). We’re a grown-up, startup. We deliver the excitement of a new venture, without the struggles and chaos that can come with a business that hasn’t stabilized.
  
  
We’re on the cutting edge of innovative technologies. We keep the customer at the center of all that we do. Our ability to meet their needs relies on the strength of a workforce as diverse as the customers we serve. We bring together employees from all walks of life and we are proud to provide the kind of inclusive environment that stimulates innovation, creativity and collaboration.
  
  
Priceline is part of the Booking Holdings, Inc. (Nasdaq: BKNG) family of companies, a highly profitable global online travel company with a market capitalization of over $80 billion. Our sister companies include Booking.com, BookingGo, Agoda, Kayak and OpenTable.
  
  
If you want to be part of something truly special, check us out!
  
  
**Flexible work at Priceline**
Priceline is following a hybrid working model, which includes two days onsite as determined by you and your manager (ideally selecting among Tuesday, Wednesday, or Thursday). On the remaining days, you can choose to be remote or in the office.
  
  
**Perks & Benefits At Priceline**
Our benefits are designed to support your health, wellbeing, and life inside and outside of work. Eligible Priceliners have access to:
  
  
**Health & wellness coverage**
including medical, dental, vision, and mental health resources
  
  
**Generous time off**
including PTO, holidays, a company-wide Priceline Pause reset week, and paid volunteer days
  
  
**Work/life support**
including the ability to work up to 4 weeks per year from anywhere, parental leave, dependent care and family support resources, Summer Fridays, and office perks like stocked kitchens and catered meals (varies by location)
  
  
**Financial security programs**
such as retirement plans with company contributions, life and disability coverage, and tax-advantaged accounts
  
  
**Signature travel perks**
including employee-only discounts on hotels and flights, VIP deals, and Big Deal Bucks credits
  
  
**Additional perks & discounts**
like travel and partner discounts, tuition support, legal support, and pet benefits
  
  
**A people-first culture**
with Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), social events, recognition programs, and service awards that help you connect, grow, and celebrate together
  
  
*Specific benefits and programs vary by location.*
**Inclusion is a Big Deal!**
To be the best travel dealmakers in the world, we believe our team should reflect the broad range of customers and communities we serve. We are committed to cultivating a culture where all employees have the freedom to bring their individual perspectives, life experiences, and passion to work.
  
  
Priceline is a proud equal opportunity employer. We embrace and celebrate the unique lenses through which our employees see the world. We’d love for you to join us and help shape what makes our team extraordinary.
  
  
**Applying for this position**
We're excited that you are interested in a career with us. For all
**current employees**
, please use the internal portal to find jobs and apply.
  
  
External candidates are required to have an account before applying. When you click Apply, returning candidates can log in, or new candidates can quickly create an account to save/view applications.

title: Architect - Data Modeller
description:
While technology is the heart of our business, a global and diverse culture is the heart of our success. We love our people and we take pride in catering them to a culture built on transparency, diversity, integrity, learning and growth.
  
  
If working in an environment that encourages you to innovate and excel, not just in professional but personal life, interests you- you would enjoy your career with Quantiphi!
  
  
**Architect Data Modeler**
**Exp Range**
: 8 - 13 Years
  
  
**Job Location**
: Mumbai , Bangalore, Trivandrum
  
  
**Role Overview**
The Data Modeler is responsible for the structural design of the platform's canonical and derived data assets. You will own the Common Data Model (CDM) at the schema level — the dimension, fact, bridge, and reference tables that hold normalized clinical, claims, and demographic data — and the source-to-target mappings (STTMs) that define how source-system data lands in CDM and how CDM data is reshaped into FHIR resources.
  
  
This role is hands-on. You will produce schema designs in collaboration with the architect, write STTM specifications that engineers implement against, and work with clinical informatics and source-system experts to ensure the model accurately reflects the data's clinical and operational meaning. Your output is the contract between source data and CDM, and between CDM and downstream consumers.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Own the schema-level design of the Common Data Model — DIM (patient, person, encounter, provider, organization), FACT (observation, diagnosis, procedure, medication administration, claim line, encounter), BRIDGE (relationship-qualifier-aware), and REF (terminology and crosswalk) tables. Design columns, types, NULL semantics, hash key composition, SCD2 patterns, and partitioning strategies in coordination with the architect
* Develop and maintain Source-to-Target Mappings (STTMs) for every source-system feed — EPIC HL7v2 ADT/ORU/ORM, Cerner HL7v2, ambulatory EHR feeds, state HIE CCDA, payer claims CSVs, FHIR ingestion. STTMs specify field-by-field source-path → CDM-column mapping with explicit transformation, NULL handling, and validation rules
* Develop and maintain STTMs for FHIR serialization — for each in-scope US Core 6.1 resource (Patient, Encounter, Condition, Observation, Procedure, Practitioner, Organization, AllergyIntolerance), specify how every FHIR element derives from CDM columns, including cardinality, profile constraints, and terminology bindings
* Design data product schemas — the longitudinal patient mart, population analytics aggregations, risk adjustment marts, HEDIS measure pre-aggregations. Each data product has a defined grain, columns, and refresh semantics
* Author and maintain unit specs at the model level under the spec-driven development framework. Each table has a versioned spec; model changes go through the spec review process before implementation
* Collaborate with data engineers to translate model specs into dbt implementations. Review dbt model code for adherence to the spec, including column naming, hash key construction, SCD2 macro usage, and test coverage
* Participate in source-system data profiling — analyze sample data from each source to identify quality issues, edge cases, and modeling implications before specs are finalized. Profile findings drive STTM design
* Define and enforce reference data (REF) management practices — terminology crosswalks (LOINC, SNOMED, ICD-10, RxNorm, CPT), source-code-to-standard-code mappings, and the SCD2 patterns that govern reference data evolution
* Document data dictionaries, lineage, and the canonical model glossary. Engage with Atlan or equivalent governance tooling to publish model documentation for downstream consumers
* Work with clinical informaticists and source-system experts to validate that the model and STTMs accurately represent clinical reality. STTMs are the contract between engineering and clinical informatics; you own that contract

**Required Skills And Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related quantitative field
* 5+ years of data modeling experience for large-scale data warehouses, data lakes, or data platforms
* Demonstrated ability to design conceptual, logical, and physical data models — dimensional modeling (Kimball), data vault, or hybrid patterns. This project uses a Kimball-influenced canonical model with SCD2 dimensions and per-source row preservation
* Strong SQL proficiency. Experience reading and reviewing dbt SQL models is required; ability to author dbt models is a plus
* Experience modeling for analytical and operational data layers simultaneously — understanding how a normalized canonical model serves both downstream analytics and FHIR API consumers
* Hands-on experience with healthcare data standards — HL7v2 segment-level structure, CCDA document structure, and FHIR R4 resource models. Familiarity with US Core profiles and FHIR Bundle composition
* Experience producing source-to-target mappings (STTMs) at field-level granularity for multi-source data integration projects
* Experience modeling SCD2 patterns and the operational implications of late-arriving data, restatement, and version closure
* Experience with terminology systems used in healthcare — LOINC, SNOMED CT, ICD-10, CPT, RxNorm — and their crosswalk patterns
* Familiarity with Google Cloud Platform data services (Cloud Storage, BigLake, Dataproc) and open table formats. Direct Iceberg experience is a plus
* Strong written communication skills. STTMs and model documentation are read across engineering, QA, clinical, and governance audiences

Nice-to-Have Skills
  
  

* Direct experience with the Optum Health Data Engine canonical model or comparable healthcare canonical models (OMOP, PCORnet CDM, Sentinel)
* Experience with master data management modeling — patient matching attributes, source-system identifier preservation, ECI lifecycle
* Experience with Atlan or comparable governance and lineage tooling
* Hands-on dbt authorship including macros, tests, and project structure
* Familiarity with FHIR Implementation Guides beyond US Core (CARIN BB, Da Vinci, IPA)
* Experience with data modeling tools (ER/Studio, Erwin, dbdiagram, SqlDBM) for diagram production

*If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us*
*!*

description:

**Department**
: ISPL ITG Payment services
  
  
**About Business Line/Function**
IT Payment Services department, the worldwide reference for payments in the BNP Paribas Group. We are working on the many applications used worldwide.
  
  
**Position Purpose**

* Joining the Data Office IT Payment Services is a direct contribution to the Data strategy of Payment Services, working closely with the DCIO. You will evolve at the heart of a stimulating environment, at the intersection of regulatory, technological and business data-related challenges. You will take part in leading projects (data asset documentation, data flow reliability, Data architecture evolution, etc.), and will be recognized as an internal expert on the quality and governance of Payment Services data. If you recognize yourself in this profile and wish to shape the excellence and reliability of data for Payment Services and its clients, join us!
* Main mission of Data office is to ensure the quality, security, compliance, traceability, performance and continuity of data across the entire Payment Services Information System. The integrated Data Officer in this team directly contributes to this mission within the context of strengthening IT PS's Data Management governance.
* In this context, the Data Office IT PS operates according to 2 major axes:
* Compliance & protection: adherence to regulatory standards (GDPR, internal governance policies) and assurance of data protection (security, access management and traceability);
* Data quality: monitoring and continuous improvement of the quality and reliability of data, including through regular IT deliverable checks and contributing to the enhancement of business data quality.
* Missions of the Data Office IT Payment Services team:
* Governance & Compliance: Deployment of the data governance framework (charters, policies and processes) to ensure the compliance of the data ecosystem with internal regulations and standards. The team defines and monitors data management KPIs, ensures the application of protection policies (confidentiality, access) and contributes to the governance of data-related control plans. She notably chairs a Data Governance Committee to ensure alignment of data assets with IT PS's Data Management strategy. A data governance and compliance dashboard for Data Management maturity is regularly presented to the IT PS Management.
* Data Architecture & Projects: The team ensures alignment of data models with business needs and Group standards, and implements full traceability of data and data flows (data lineage). She supports projects in the Data areas (compliance, data model, data dictionaries, quality and strengthening of data security, etc.). The Data Office IT PS plays a cross-functional coordination role between business requirements, technical requirements and regulatory obligations in order to achieve quality and compliance objectives.
* Support and assistance: The team trains and raises awareness among staff on tools and best practices (e.g. Data Management tools, data dictionary, flow mapping, compliance with quality and security standards, Data Privacy principles She also ensures the daily monitoring of Data topics (KPI monitoring, on-site support, responses to requests) to embed the Data culture and governance rigor in daily operations.

**Responsibilities**
Direct Responsibilities
  
  

* Data Governance & Data Reference Frameworks: Manage data reference frameworks (application data dictionaries) using the internal data cataloging tool (WeData – based on Collibra). You ensure comprehensive documentation of key data (shared definitions, metadata, owners) and proper alignment of technical and business frameworks.
* Modeling & Data Lineage: Collaborate closely with project teams and the IT Data Manager to ensure the design of application data models, guaranteeing their consistency and completeness in line with business needs. You ensure documentation and maintenance of data traceability across all flows (data lineage), providing end-to-end visibility of every critical data point from its source to its consumption (a prerequisite for managing risks and ensuring compliance).
* Data Quality: Ensure the implementation and execution of data quality control plans defined by the business, by steering continuous improvement action plans dedicated to critical data. As an expert, you share your analyses and recommendations to improve data quality and strengthen trust in their use.
* Operational support & continuous improvement: Supporting and raising awareness among technical and business teams on a daily basis on Data topics: training in the use of governance tools (data dictionary, data flow mapping), advice on good data management practices, and responses to specific requests. You propose solutions to continuously improve data resilience and integrity, and contribute to the optimization of governance processes.
* KPI Data Management: Contributing to the production of the Data Management Dashboard.

Contributing Responsibilities
  
  

* Ability to drive and contribute to Data projects (quality, security, architecture, etc.) in a cross-functional manner, in a complex environment.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a sense of rigor to formalize and document results (reports, traceability matrices).

**Technical & Behavioral Competencies**

* Data Modeling & Management – Mastery of conceptual, logical, and physical data models; strong knowledge of databases and data integration technologies (ETL/ELT, data pipelines).
* Data Catalogue & Data Lineage – Practical experience with a cataloging/metadata tool (ideally weData/Collibra or equivalent) to manage data dictionaries. Solid understanding of data lineage principles and ability to document data flow traceability.
* Data Quality & Compliance – Knowledge of data quality standards and methods, as well as experience in implementing quality controls. Awareness of regulatory compliance issues (GDPR), data governance and security.
* Data Visualization: Hands-on experience with a Data Visualization tool (Power BI, Tableau...)
* Excellent communication skills, able to simplify Data issues and train/evangelize various stakeholders (IT teams, business units, management).
* Team spirit and ease in collaboration with multiple players (IT Data Manager, developers, business referents, Security teams…).
* Autonomy, proactivity and ability to propose improvements to continuously enhance data governance processes.
* Strong interest in data quality and enhancement, with a strong sense of ethics and confidentiality

**Specific Qualifications**

* Minimum experience of 6 - 9 years in a function related to data management (Data Governance, Data Quality, Data Analyst/Engineer where there is a governance dimension).
* Bachelor's Degree or Higher education (Engineer or Master 2) in computer science, data management or related field.

title: Sr. Software Development Engineer
description:
Clearwater Analytics’ mission is to become the world’s most trusted and comprehensive technology platform for investment reporting, accounting, and analytics. With our team, you will partner with the most sophisticated and innovative institutional investors around the world. If you are infectiously passionate about what you do, intensely committed to clients, and driven by continuous innovation and improvement... We want you to apply!
  
  
We are looking for Java and Python developers to design and build scalable, cloud-native platforms for OTC and listed derivatives. You will work on trade capture, valuation, lifecycle events, risk, and post-trade processing across Interest Rate Derivatives (IRD), Credit Derivatives (CRD), FX Derivatives (FXD), and related asset classes. You will work closely with product, quants, and operations to turn complex financial workflows into reliable, well-designed software.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, and maintain high-performance services for derivative trade lifecycle management, valuation, pricing, risk, collateral, and reporting.
* Own the technical design of new modules and features, including architecture, data models, APIs, and integration patterns.
* Build cloud-native microservices and data pipelines using containers and managed services.
* Model and process derivative products (swaps, swaptions, caps/floors, CDS, FX forwards/options/NDFs) and their lifecycle events (resets, fixings, amendments, novations, terminations, compressions).
* Write clean, testable, well-documented code, and take part in code and design reviews.
* Improve the performance, resilience, and observability of production systems, and help resolve complex production issues.
* Mentor junior engineers and help raise engineering standards (senior profiles).

**Required Qualifications**

* 6–12 years of software development experience, with at least 2 years in derivative asset classes (IRD, CRD, FXD, or equivalent).
* Strong hands-on skills in Java (8/11/17+) and/or Python 3.x. Working knowledge of both is a plus.
* Hands-on cloud development experience on AWS including containers (Docker, Kubernetes), CI/CD, and infrastructure-as-code.
* Excellent design skills: OOP, SOLID, design patterns, domain-driven design, microservices, event-driven architecture, and REST/gRPC API design.
* Working knowledge of derivative concepts: pricing and valuation basics,curves, trade lifecycle, and clearing/margining.
* Proficiency with relational and NoSQL databases (PostgreSQL, Oracle, MongoDB, etc.) and messaging systems (Kafka, RabbitMQ, or similar).
* Strong unit, integration, and automated testing practices.
* Strong problem-solving and communication skills, and the ability to work with business stakeholders.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with frameworks such as Spring Boot and FastAPI.
* Experience with distributed computing and low-latency design
* Exposure to observability tooling (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Datadog) and Agile/DevOps practices.
* Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Finance, or a related field. Certifications such as CFA, FRM are a plus.

title: Senior Manager - Database Administration
description:
**Job Summary:**

Owns the airline's database platforms and cloud data architecture on AWS. Designs purpose-built data solutions, runs resilient and cost-efficient database operations, and leads the move from traditional engines to managed cloud services.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Cloud data architecture**

* Design data architectures on AWS using purpose-built services: Aurora and RDS (PostgreSQL, MySQL), DynamoDB, ElastiCache, Redshift and an S3-based data lake with Glue, Athena and Lake Formation.
* Select the right engine per workload on performance, resilience and cost; publish reference architectures and database standards.
* Plan and execute migrations from SQL Server, Oracle and self-managed MySQL to Aurora and RDS using AWS DMS and SCT.
* Design data integration with SaaS and line-of-business systems: CDC, event streams (Kinesis, MSK) and APIs.

**Database operations and resilience**

* Own availability, performance and capacity of production databases; lead P1 database incident response.
* Run high availability and DR: Multi-AZ, Aurora Global Database, cross-region replicas, AWS Backup and point-in-time recovery across the Mumbai and Hyderabad regions.
* Tune performance using Performance Insights, Enhanced Monitoring, execution plans and indexing.
* Plan patching and major version upgrades with minimal downtime, using blue/green deployments where supported.

**Automation, security and cost**

* Provision and change databases as code (Terraform or CloudFormation) with versioned schema pipelines
* Enforce encryption (KMS), secret rotation (Secrets Manager), IAM database authentication, least privilege and audit logging.
* Apply data protection controls for ISO 27001 and the DPDP Act 2023, including masking of non-production data.
* Drive database FinOps: rightsizing, Graviton instances, Savings Plans or reserved capacity and storage tiering.

**Leadership and collaboration**

* Mentor and develop the Junior DBA as trained backup for routine operations.
* Partner with application, development and analytics teams on data models and query design.
* Manage AWS support cases and database vendor relationships.

**Skills and Experience:**

**Essential**

* Deep hands-on expertise with Aurora and RDS for PostgreSQL and MySQL, including replication, failover and parameter tuning.
* AWS data services: DynamoDB, Redshift, S3, Glue, Athena and DMS.
* Migration of SQL Server or Oracle workloads to open-source engines on AWS.
* Infrastructure-as-Code and scripting in Python or Bash.
* Strong SQL, data modelling and performance diagnostics.

**Advantageous**

* Streaming and CDC (Kinesis, MSK).
* Data warehouse and lakehouse design for reporting and analytics.
* Airline, travel or other high-volume transactional systems

**Qualifications and Certifications**

* B.E. / B.Tech or MCA in Computer Science or IT.
* Required: AWS Certified Data Engineer – Associate, or AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate with equivalent data platform experience.
* Preferred: AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional, AWS Certified Security – Specialty, PostgreSQL professional certification.

title: Senior Applications Technical Specialist
description:

description:

We produce globally recognized brands and build leaders across functions. You'll work in an environment that values ownership, innovation, and continuous learning - with the opportunity to make a real impact early in your career.

As Priceline expands its use of data, real-time analytics, machine learning, and GenAI, reliable platform engineering is critical to delivering business value safely and efficiently.
  
  
You will help operate the platform foundation behind data pipelines, ML pipelines, model endpoints, and LLM workloads. Your work will improve deployment speed, platform reliability, cost visibility, security, and the self-service experience for data and ML engineering teams.
  
  
This role is focused on platform engineering and operations. Data and ML teams own business logic, model development, testing, and domain-level data quality; the MLOps & DataOps team owns the infrastructure, deployment paths, automation, governance, and reliability practices that enable those workloads
**.**
**In This Role, You Will**

* Cloud Platform Infrastructure & Automation
* Architect, govern, and scale enterprise-grade Terraform module registries and infrastructure-as-code strategies for GCP data and ML platform services.

* Implement reliable deployment, promotion, validation, rollback, and release processes using Git-based workflows.

* Design and engineer scalable self-service frameworks that allow data and ML teams to provision and deploy workloads safely without bypassing governance controls.
* Improve developer experience, deployment reliability, and time to production through standardization and automation.
* MLOps & LLMOps Platform Operations
* Architect and optimize production ML workflows covering model training, pipeline execution, model deployment, endpoint operations, batch inference, and retraining.
* Operate and improve ML platforms based on Vertex AI, Kubernetes/GKE, Docker, Kubeflow, or equivalent technologies.

* Define and enforce repeatable enterprise standards for model versioning, artifact management, model registries, feature stores, and data/model lineage.
* Drive GenAI, RAG, model evaluation, guardrails, and AI observability capabilities.
* Monitoring, Observability, Security & SRE
* Define and operate monitoring, logging, alerting, and reliability practices for data pipelines, ML pipelines, model endpoints, and platform services.
* Establish meaningful SLIs/SLOs, escalation paths, runbooks, and error-management practices.
* Lead tier-3 incident response for complex infrastructure failures and drive systemic architectural changes to prevent recurrence.
* Lead tier-3 incident response for complex infrastructure failures and drive systemic architectural changes to prevent recurrence.
* Participate in on-call support, lead blameless root-cause analysis (RCAs), and enforce corrective and preventative actions.
* Architect IAM, RBAC, service-account controls, vulnerability scanning, secrets management, and compliance guardrails into platform workflows.
* Cost, Governance, Leadership & Platform Enablement
* Mentor mid-level and junior engineers, lead complex cross-team technical initiatives, and establish engineering standards for the broader MLOps and DataOps domains.
* Own and optimize cloud architecture for cost efficiency, actively managing capacity and FinOps practices for large-scale data and ML workloads.
* Evaluate, adopt, and operationalize platform capabilities that improve reliability, security, developer productivity, and operational efficiency.
* Partner with Cloud Infrastructure, SRE, InfoSec, Data Engineering, Data Science, and ML teams to resolve platform and operational issues.

**Who You Are**

* Degree & Experience: B.Tech or B.E in Computer Science, Information technology, or equivalent practical experience, with 7+ years of experience in DevOps, SRE, cloud platform engineering, MLOps, DataOps, or a closely related discipline.
* Cloud Infrastructure: Strong hands-on experience with Google Cloud Platform or equivalent public cloud technologies. Experience with GCP services such as Cloud Composer, Dataproc, Dataflow, BigQuery, Google Cloud Storage, or Vertex AI is highly relevant.
* Infrastructure as Code: Strong practical experience with Terraform for infrastructure provisioning, configuration management, reusable modules, and controlled production changes.
* Containers & Kubernetes: Hands-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes. Experience with GKE is preferred for GCP environments.
* CI/CD & GitOps: Experience building or operating CI/CD pipelines and Git-based deployment workflows using GitHub Actions, Argo CD, Codefresh, Jenkins, or equivalent tools.
* Automation & Scripting: Proficiency in Python and Shell scripting for platform automation, operational tooling, pipeline hooks, and internal utilities.
* Data & Workflow Platforms: Experience supporting Apache Airflow/Composer, Dataproc, Dataflow, Spark, BigQuery, or comparable data-processing and workflow-orchestration technologies.
* MLOps: Experience supporting ML pipelines, model deployments, inference endpoints, model-serving infrastructure, or ML platform operations.
* Reliability & Operations: Experience with monitoring, logging, alerting, incident response, on-call support, troubleshooting, and root-cause analysis for production systems.
* Security & Governance: Working knowledge of IAM, RBAC, service accounts, secrets, vulnerability management, networking fundamentals, and secure cloud operations.
* Operational Mindset: Strong ownership, structured problem-solving, documentation, communication, and collaboration skills.

* Experience with ML/LLM observability and evaluation platforms such as Arize, LangSmith, or equivalent tools.
* Experience with GKE platform operations, GPU workloads, vector databases, RAG infrastructure, or model-serving systems.
* Experience implementing data, model, artifact, or pipeline lineage and reproducibility practices.

title: Member of Technical Staff
description:
**About us**

Triton Infotech works with large, diverse datasets for AI development and enterprise use. We bring together structured and unstructured data from many sources and prepare it for secure storage, evaluation and delivery.

**The role**

A hands-on engineering role. You’ll own the pipeline that turns incoming data into an organised, verified, usable repository, working directly with terabyte- to petabyte-scale data, storage hardware, cloud platforms and AI-assisted workflows. You should be as comfortable debugging a failed transfer at the command line as managing a NAS or designing a repeatable ingestion and quality-check process.

**What you’ll do**

* **Data collection and ingestion:**
  coordinate receipt of datasets from multiple partners in India and abroad, via disks, NAS shares, secure links, cloud buckets and hosted repositories, and build reliable bulk upload, download and sync workflows.
* **Centralisation and organisation:**
  consolidate incoming data into Google Workspace and cloud object storage (GCS, S3, Azure Blob) with clear directory structures, naming conventions, metadata catalogues and source-level inventories.
* **NAS and storage systems:**
  configure, run and troubleshoot network-attached storage (SMB, NFS, rsync, SFTP/SSH), including RAID, permissions, snapshots, disk health, throughput, backup and recovery.
* **Cloud infrastructure:**
  work across GCP, AWS and Azure (compute, object storage, IAM, CLIs, lifecycle policies, transfer tools, logging and cost controls), and choose approaches based on volume, security, performance and budget.
* **Systems work:**
  use Linux, shell scripting and Python to automate file handling, large transfers and transformations, and diagnose filesystem, network, memory and disk I/O bottlenecks.
* **File-format fluency:**
  inspect, validate, convert and extract data across PDF, DOCX, TXT, CSV, JSON, XML, images, video, audio, archives, databases and engineering/CAD formats (DWG, DXF, STEP, STL, IFC).
* **Cleaning and QA:**
  find duplicates, corrupt or incomplete files, inconsistent metadata and missing records, using checksums, deduplication, schema validation, batch transformation and exception reports.
* **AI-enabled operations:**
  use Claude, ChatGPT and coding assistants to speed up scripting, classification, metadata extraction and QA, with proper review steps, and never share restricted data with external AI tools without authorisation.
* **Traceability and governance:**
  keep a record of every batch (when it arrived, where from, file count, size, format, changes made, access restrictions and delivery status), with least-privilege access, encryption and retention controls.
* **Operational ownership:**
  monitor ingestion jobs, maintain runbooks and dashboards, resolve transfer failures, coordinate with partners and the internal team, and deliver organised, verified datasets on time.

**What we’re looking for**

* Hands-on experience in data engineering, infrastructure, DevOps or systems administration, with large and varied datasets
* Strong Linux, Python and Bash skills
* Experience with at least one major cloud platform and with large file transfers (rclone, rsync, cloud CLIs)
* Familiarity with NAS, file-transfer protocols, permissions and backups
* Careful, well documented and security-minded; able to own work end to end
* B.Tech / B.E. in Computer Science or a related field

**Nice to have**

* Experience with multi-terabyte or petabyte-scale repositories, Docker, Git, SQL or OCR / document-processing pipelines

title: Operating System Engineer
description:
Required Background and Prior Experience

We are seeking a hands-on engineer who has previously built and supported production healthcare software comparable to VerityOS.

1. Relevant healthcare product experience — mandatory

The candidate must have personally developed substantial components of a live U.S. healthcare product involving one or more of the following:

\* Practice management.

\* Medical billing and revenue cycle management.

\* EHR-connected patient engagement and operational workflows.

The product must have been used by real healthcare organizations. Coursework, prototypes, chatbot demonstrations, and internal proof-of-concept projects alone do not qualify.

2. Billing and RCM engineering experience — mandatory

The candidate must have hands-on experience implementing healthcare billing workflows, including:

\* Claim creation/submission and acknowledgment or rejection handling.

\* Electronic remittance or EOB processing and payment posting.

\* Denial management and accounts-receivable workflows.

\* Patient balances, adjustments, and reconciliation.

They must understand the distinction between charges, claims, payments, adjustments, and patient responsibility, and explain how their system prevented duplicate transactions and preserved financial history.

They do not need to have built every billing component independently, but must clearly identify the components they personally implemented.

3. EHR or healthcare-system integration experience — mandatory

The candidate must have delivered at least one production integration with an EHR, practice-management system, or healthcare clearinghouse.

Relevant experience includes approved APIs, FHIR, HL7, healthcare transaction interfaces, or secure data exchanges.

They must demonstrate experience with patient matching, synchronization, conflicting updates, failed transactions, and reconciliation. General API experience alone is insufficient.

4. Secure application architecture — mandatory

The candidate must have implemented:

\* Role-based permissions and server-side access controls.

\* Audit trails and sensitive-data protection.

\* Separation of customer organizations’ data.

\* Secure credential management.

\* Backup, recovery, monitoring, and incident handling.

Experience with a platform serving multiple independent practices or customer organizations is strongly preferred.

5. Hands-on full-stack development — mandatory

The candidate must be able to personally design databases, develop backend services and user interfaces, write meaningful tests, deploy applications, and troubleshoot production issues.

This is a building role, not solely a project-management, consulting, or architecture role.

6. Production ownership — mandatory

The candidate must have supported a product after launch, including resolving incidents, releasing upgrades, managing database changes, and maintaining integrations.

They should be able to describe a significant production failure, its impact, how it was resolved, and what was changed to prevent recurrence.

7. Workflow automation experience — mandatory

The candidate must have built workflows involving task assignment, statuses, deadlines, escalation, document handling, and external-system events.

They must understand how to handle retries, duplicate events, incomplete information, and human review.

8. AI and communications experience — strongly preferred

Preference will be given to candidates who have deployed:

\* AI document extraction with validation.

\* Tool-using AI agents with defined permissions and human handoff.

\* Voice agents or telephony integrations.

\* Two-way SMS, e-fax, or secure patient messaging.

Candidates must distinguish production deployments from experimental projects.

9. Patient-facing and specialty experience — preferred

Relevant additional experience includes patient portals, caregiver access, scheduling, authorization workflows, procedure-resource scheduling, infusions, or other specialty-practice operations.

Neurology experience is valuable but not mandatory.

Evidence required with the application

Please provide two relevant project examples. For each, describe:

\* The product and type of healthcare organization it served.

\* Whether it reached production and how long you supported it.

\* Your exact role and the components you personally built.

\* EHRs, clearinghouses, or communications systems integrated.

\* The scale of deployment, where disclosure is permitted.

\* A difficult technical problem and how you resolved it.

\* A professional reference who can verify your contribution.

Confidential client names may be withheld initially. Use anonymized descriptions and synthetic data; do not disclose patient information or proprietary code.

title: Manager - Cloud Operations Lead
description:
****Job Summary****
At Sun Pharma, we commit to helping you “
**Create your own sunshine**
”— by fostering an environment where you grow at every step, take charge of your journey and thrive in a supportive community.
  
  
****Are You Ready to Create Your Own Sunshine?****
As you enter the Sun Pharma world, you’ll find yourself becoming ‘Better every day’ through continuous progress. Exhibit self-drive as you ‘Take charge’ and lead with confidence. Additionally, demonstrate a collaborative spirit, knowing that we ‘Thrive together’ and support each other’s journeys.”
  
  
****Job Summary:****
We are looking for a hands-on Cloud Operations Lead to run the day-to-day operations of our AWS-primary cloud estate (with a fast-growing Azure footprint) and to own and drive DevSecOps across the organisation. Reporting to the Cloud Architect within the Cloud CoE, the role spans three areas: cloud operations (about half the role), cloud-security remediation (about a quarter), and DevSecOps ownership, adoption and governance (about a quarter). In practice that means running the reliability and cost-efficiency of the cloud estate, closing security findings and hardening the environment, and owning the DevSecOps toolchain while driving its adoption and governance across delivery teams. It is a deeply technical, execution-focused role for an engineer equally comfortable in infrastructure-as-code, pipeline security, incident response, and directing a managed-services partner pool.
  
  
On the operations side, you will operate and continuously improve the landing zones, networking, and platform services designed by the Cloud Architect — primarily on AWS, and increasingly on Azure as that estate grows. You will run monitoring and observability, drive incident, problem, and change management to resolution, and enforce operational guardrails, patching, and backup/DR routines across environments. You will act as the operational owner of the NTT DATA cloud and DevSecOps managed-services pool, holding the partner to SLAs and quality standards.
  
  
On the security and DevSecOps side, you will remediate cloud-security findings and harden the estate, and own the DevSecOps toolchain and practice end-to-end — building and maintaining secure CI/CD pipelines, integrating SAST, DAST, SCA, secrets-scanning, and image/container security into the delivery flow, and shifting security left. You will define secure-pipeline standards, onboard and enable delivery teams, and actively drive DevSecOps adoption and maturity across the organisation, in line with CISO requirements. Across both halves of the role you will maintain infrastructure-as-code, automate operational toil, support cloud cost/FinOps optimisation, and work within the architecture standards and guardrails set by the Cloud Architect and the Enterprise Architecture Review Board (EARB), escalating design changes rather than making them unilaterally.
  
  
**Areas Of Responsibility**
**Area of Responsibility**
****Responsibilities****
**Cloud Operations & Reliability (~50%)**
Operate and maintain the AWS-primary cloud estate (and growing Azure footprint) for reliability and availability against agreed SLOs.
  
  
Own monitoring, alerting, and observability across infrastructure and platform services.
  
  
Drive incident, problem, and change management to timely resolution, including on-call/major-incident response.
  
  
Operate landing zones, networking, and platform services within the guardrails set by the Cloud Architect.
  
  
Maintain infrastructure-as-code (Terraform primary; CloudFormation / Bicep / ARM) to provision and change environments consistently.
  
  
**Automation & Platform Engineering**
Automate operational toil across provisioning, monitoring, and scaling.
  
  
Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure and platform deployments in collaboration with DevOps/DevSecOps.
  
  
Perform operational debugging, root-cause analysis, and performance tuning; document runbooks and share operational knowledge.
  
  
Operate backup, restore, and disaster-recovery routines; verify recoverability and data availability.
  
  
Implement and maintain configuration management and environment consistency across dev, test, and production.
  
  
Maintain platform health across integrated components and dependencies.
  
  
Track operational metrics and keep stakeholders informed of service health and incidents.
  
  
**Cloud Security Remediation & Hardening (~25%)**
Implement and operate cloud security and DevSecOps controls in line with CISO requirements.
  
  
Own the cloud-security remediation backlog: triage findings from CSPM, Security Hub / Defender, and CISO reviews, and drive them to closure within SLA.
  
  
Apply patching, hardening, and encryption/key-management routines across the estate.
  
  
Remediate vulnerabilities and misconfigurations across accounts/subscriptions; harden baselines and prevent regression.
  
  
Continuously monitor cloud posture (CSPM) and report remediation status, risk burn-down, and exceptions to the CISO office.
  
  
Ensure controls and remediation evidence are audit-ready (GxP, GDPR, HIPAA); support security reviews and audits.
  
  
**Scalability and Performance**
Optimise platform performance, scaling, and resource utilisation against SLOs.
  
  
Perform capacity planning and autoscaling configuration for cloud workloads.
  
  
Identify and resolve operational bottlenecks; right-size resources for cost and performance.
  
  
**DevSecOps Ownership, Adoption & Governance (~25%)**
Own the DevSecOps toolchain end-to-end and integrate security scanning (SAST, DAST, SCA, secrets, IaC scanning) into CI/CD pipelines.
  
  
Embed image/container and Kubernetes security (registry scanning, admission controls, policy-as-code) into the delivery flow.
  
  
Define secure-pipeline standards and reusable templates; maintain release hygiene for continuous, safe delivery.
  
  
Drive DevSecOps adoption across delivery teams: onboard projects, run enablement, and track maturity uptake.
  
  
Establish and report DevSecOps KPIs (pipeline coverage, scan pass rates, mean-time-to-remediate, adoption %).
  
  
Manage secrets, keys, and certificates and enforce supply-chain security (SBOM, dependency and artifact integrity).
  
  
Own DevSecOps governance: define policy, standards, and gates in coordination with the CISO and EARB, and enforce them across teams.
  
  
**Continuous Improvement & Vendor Oversight**
Own the NTT DATA cloud managed-services pool: assign work, hold to SLAs, and review quality.
  
  
Track operational best practices and drive continuous improvement of run processes.
  
  
Propose and implement automation and tooling improvements to reduce toil and cost.
  
  
Pilot operational tooling (monitoring, FinOps, automation) with the Cloud Architect’s endorsement.
  
  
Feed operational insights back into architecture and standards via the Cloud Architect / EARB.
  
  
**Stakeholder Collaboration, Communication and Reporting**
Interface with application, infrastructure, and business teams to understand operational needs.
  
  
Coordinate with external partners, vendors, and technology providers on operational delivery.
  
  
Coordinate cross-functional teams during incidents, changes, and releases.
  
  
Ensure operations meet agreed service levels and business expectations.
  
  
Clearly communicate service health, incidents, and root causes to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  
  
Provide regular operational reporting (availability, incidents, cost) to the Cloud Architect and management.
  
  
**Operational Delivery & Run Management**
Own operational delivery of the cloud run function, including SLAs and service reviews.
  
  
Ensure operational commitments are met within agreed timelines and budget.
  
  
Manage the managed-services pool and schedules for operational execution.
  
  
**Travel Estimate**
**Job Scope**
**Internal Interactions (within the organization)**
Function Heads, business vertical leads/end users , procurement , SUN Infrastructure Teams (Network, Server, Database, Security), vendor payment, commercial, SAP support & other as necessary
  
  
**External Interactions (outside the organization)**
OEM, SI’s others partners/vendors/service providers in the space as applicable
  
  
**Geographical Scope**
Global
  
  
**Financial Accountability (cost/revenue with exclusive authority)**

* Cost Management:
* Execute cloud cost/FinOps optimisation: right-sizing, reserved-capacity actions, and waste elimination.
* Monitor daily cloud expenditure and enforce tagging, budgets, and lifecycle policies on storage and compute.
* Provide regular cost analysis and anomaly alerts to identify savings, escalating structural decisions to the Cloud Architect.
* Budgeting and Forecasting:
* Assist in preparing and tracking the cloud services run budget.
* Forecast run-rate cloud costs and flag variances early.
* Ensure operational cloud spend stays aligned to approved budgets.
* Vendor and Contract Management:
* Manage day-to-day relationship and tickets with cloud service providers.
* Support commercial reviews with usage data; recommend cost actions (final negotiation owned by the Cloud Architect / management).

Track consumption against contractual commitments and flag over/under-utilisation.
  
  
****Job Requirements****
**Educational Qualification**
**Specific Certification**
Mandatory Certifications
**(at least 01 in each group)**

* Cloud Certification (one or more of the following):

+ AWS Certified SysOps Administrator – Associate
+ AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate (Azure Administrator AZ-104 a plus, given the growing Azure estate)
+ Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA)
+ Security Certification (one or more of the following):

  
  

+ AWS Certified Security – Specialty (or CCSP)
+ DevSecOps / pipeline security credential — e.g. GitLab Security Specialist, GitHub Advanced Security, or Certified DevSecOps Professional (CDP)
+ DevOps Certification (one or more of the following):

  
  

+ AWS Certified DevOps Engineer – Professional
+ HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate
+ Microsoft Certified: DevOps Engineer Expert (AZ-400) — value-add for Azure

Optional Certifications (any one of more of below will be a value add))
  
  

+ ITIL 4 Foundation (service operations)
+ FinOps Certified Practitioner

****Experience****
6–10 years in cloud operations / cloud engineering, running production cloud environments (AWS primary; Azure growing). Blend of experience across the three areas of this role: cloud operations (~50% — monitoring, incident/change, IaC, vendor oversight), cloud-security remediation (~25% — CSPM/vulnerability closure, hardening, CISO-aligned), and DevSecOps (~25% — CI/CD security, toolchain ownership, adoption and governance).
  
  

* Skill (Functional & Behavioural):

Functional Skills
  
  

+ Cloud Operations: Hands-on expertise operating AWS (primary) and Azure (growing) — landing zones, networking, compute, storage, and platform services in production.
+ Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Strong hands-on skills with Terraform (primary) and CloudFormation (Bicep / ARM a plus) to provision and change infrastructure.
+ Monitoring & Observability: Proficiency with AWS CloudWatch (Azure Monitor / Log Analytics a plus), Grafana/Prometheus or equivalent; alerting and SLO management.
+ Incident, Problem & Change Management: Practical ITIL-aligned operations, including on-call and major-incident handling and RCA.
+ DevOps & Automation: CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps / GitHub Actions / GitLab CI), scripting (PowerShell / Bash / Python) to automate operational tasks.
+ Containers & Networking: Working knowledge of Kubernetes/AKS and cloud networking (VNet/VPC, subnets, VPN, load balancing, DNS, firewalls).
+ DevSecOps (~25%): Owning CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI / GitHub Actions / Jenkins / AWS CodePipeline) with integrated SAST, DAST, SCA, secrets and IaC scanning; container/K8s security; secure-pipeline standards; and driving org-wide adoption. Plus cloud security operations — patching, hardening, key management, and CSPM remediation under CISO guidance.
+ Cost / FinOps & Vendor Oversight: AWS Cost Explorer / Budgets (Azure Cost Management a plus), tagging/lifecycle governance; directing a managed-services (e.g., NTT DATA) pool to SLAs.
+ Behavioural Skills

  
  


* Analytical Thinking: Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to analyse complex technical issues and make data-driven decisions.
* Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
* Collaboration and Teamwork: Proven ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams and collaborate with various stakeholders.
* Adaptability: Quick learner who can adapt to new technologies and methodologies, and adjust to changing project requirements.
* Ownership & Vendor Management: Strong operational ownership and the ability to direct and hold a managed-services partner to account (rather than line-managing a Sun team).
* Attention to Detail: High level of accuracy and commitment to maintaining high standards in technical implementations.
* Customer Focus: Understanding of business requirements and dedication to providing excellent support and service to internal and external customers.

**Your Success Matters to Us**
At Sun Pharma, your success and well-being are our top priorities! We provide robust benefits and opportunities to foster personal and professional growth. Join us at Sun Pharma, where every day is an opportunity to grow, collaborate, and make a lasting impact. Let’s create a brighter future together!

title: Data Steward, SAPAC (contract)
description:
**With a passion for life**
Join our diverse teams of passionate people and a career that allows you to develop both personally and professionally. At Getinge we exist to make life-saving technology accessible for more people. To make a true difference for our customers – and to save more lives, we need team players, forward thinkers, and game changers.
  
  
Are you looking for an inspiring career? You just found it.
  
  
**Please Note - This is a 24-month contractual position**
**Job Purpose**
The Data Steward is the operational execution lead for commercial data quality across SAPAC, supporting the Data Coordinator and the respective business data owners. The role performs recurring data verification, audits, sampling and correction activities, directly supports designated markets, and produces the reporting required to identify and resolve data quality issues — flagging the underlying cause of each issue so that it can be addressed at source.
  
  
**Output: accurate data, completed corrections under owner approval, managed exceptions, root causes flagged, and timely data quality reporting.**
**Key Responsibilities**
**Recurring verification and reporting (all markets, under the agreed allocation)**

* Post-load price verification after every price load: sample SKUs against the approved price file and flag mismatches for correction (accuracy — distinct from the Data Coordinator's quarterly audit of timeliness)
* All cost-to-price reconciliation: spare parts each price-increase cycle (selling price versus current transfer price per part, flagging negative or below-threshold margins) and completeness checks on capital and consumables reconciliation
* Monthly contract-expiry report per market: contracts expiring within 90 days with no renewal action, and the on-time renewal rate
* Monthly preventive-maintenance completion reporting using the regional tracker template
* Quarterly customer-master-to-pricing audits where applicable: affiliations, hierarchies and classifications that drive pricing conditions
* Quarterly customer master hygiene runs: duplicate detection, entity and payer verification, classification checks
* Quarterly point-of-sale service-contract reconciliation and warranty-versus-installation allocation sampling
* Rotating monthly contract-record completeness sampling by market (expiry, pricing and coverage fields)
* For every recurring exception, record the likely underlying cause (process, ownership, system) alongside the correction, so patterns can be addressed by the Data Coordinator and the business owner

**Direct execution for designated markets (primary executor)**

* Prepare, validate and load price files into SAP for designated markets — reviewed by the Data Coordinator, verified and signed off by the market's Finance Director
* Execute installed base corrections and cleansing, customer master de-duplication and corrections, and contract-record completion, each under business-owner approval
* Capture point-of-sale service contracts into the portfolio and maintain preventive-maintenance tracking where local capacity is limited
* Enter and maintain distributor installation and end-customer data received under the regional collection standard
* Keep the execution log: every change, its approving data owner, and turnaround — reported to the Steering Committee via the Lead

**Installed base (all markets)**

* Execute the corrections arising from the installed base accuracy programme coordinated by the Data Coordinator; maintain the underlying data for the country accuracy score

**Support and enablement**

* Handle hands-on support requests from non-designated markets — price-file validation, IB corrections, de-duplication — logged and reported, with the Steering Committee managing the balance against verification work
* Maintain the single current repository of data SOPs using existing global platforms (GetBasic, GetLibrary, GetQMS, the Finance Manual) rather than local copies
* Produce one-page filter, currency and refresh-cycle guides for the global dashboards and support market training

**Phase 2 (from month 6, gated)**

* Zone and region performance reporting for India, building on work already under way with the Service Director
* Account-history and customer summary requests for sales and service teams, once scoped by the Steering Committee

**Requirements**
**Must have:**

* 4–8 years in data operations, master data maintenance, finance operations, order management or service administration
* Hands-on SAP experience in at least two of: customer master, material master, pricing conditions, equipment and service-contract records — including creating and maintaining records, not only reporting on them
* Advanced Excel (lookups, pivots, reconciliations); Power BI a strong advantage
* Meticulous attention to detail and the persistence to work through large record sets methodically
* The habit of asking why an error occurred — able to recognise when a data problem is really a process or ownership problem, and to say so
* Good written and spoken English; able to explain an exception clearly to a colleague in another country
* Comfortable working across cultures and time zones with people who do not report to you

**Good To Have**

* An analytics background or interest — the role has a Phase 2 pathway into reporting and analytics work
* Medical-device, pharmaceutical or other regulated-industry experience
* Exposure to service-contract or installed-base administration
* Experience with distributor or channel data

**About Us**
With a firm belief that every person and community should have access to the best possible care, Getinge provides hospitals and life science institutions with products and solutions aiming to improve clinical results and optimize workflows. The offering includes products and solutions for intensive care, cardiovascular procedures, operating rooms, sterile reprocessing and life science. Getinge employs over 12,000 people worldwide and the products are sold in more than 135 countries.
  
  
Reasonable accommodations are available upon request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

title: Assistant Manager, CRM
description:
**About the Company**

BDO is a global network of professional services firms with a presence in over 166 countries, revenue of over USD 14 billion, and experience of over 60 years. Its a leading service provider for the mid-markets with client service at its heart.

BDO India Services Private Limited (or BDO India) is the India member firm of BDO International. BDO India offers strategic, operational, accounting and tax, and regulatory advisory & assistance for both domestic and international organizations across a range of industries. BDO India is led by more than 300+ Partners & Directors with a team of over 10,000 professionals operating across 14 cities and 20 offices. We expect to grow sizably in the coming 3-5 years, adding various dimensions to our business and multiplying and increasing the current team size multi-fold.

**Role Overview**

BDO India is seeking a detail-oriented and process-driven Assistant Manager – CRM Data Management & Operations to oversee the integrity, quality, and governance of customer and business development data within Microsoft Dynamics 365 (D365).

The role will be responsible for driving CRM data quality initiatives, managing stakeholder data requests, ensuring compliance with Master Data Management (MDM) standards, supporting user onboarding and access management, and partnering with internal teams to continuously improve CRM processes and data governance practices.

This position requires strong analytical capabilities, hands-on CRM administration experience, stakeholder management skills, and a proactive approach to driving operational excellence.

**Key Responsibilities**

**CRM Data Governance & Quality Management**

* Ensure the completeness, accuracy, consistency, and integrity of CRM data across Accounts, Contacts, Leads, Opportunities, Quotes, and Orders.
* Conduct regular audits of CRM records against defined MDM standards and implement corrective actions to address data quality gaps.
* Lead data cleansing, de-duplication, validation, and enrichment initiatives to improve overall CRM data health.
* Maintain and monitor CRM data quality scorecards, identifying trends, risks, and areas requiring remediation.
* Track compliance with CRM data entry standards across business units and prepare periodic management reports.
* Identify recurring data quality issues and recommend process improvements to strengthen governance controls.
* Maintain documentation including data dictionaries, governance guidelines, audit logs, and process documentation.

**CRM Operations & Data Request Management**

* Manage the firm's CRM Data Request Management process, ensuring timely and accurate resolution of stakeholder requests.
* Review and approve account creation requests in line with established governance protocols.
* Facilitate backend creation and maintenance of Accounts, Contacts, and Leads within D365.
* Ensure adherence to defined service levels for all requests:
* Standard Requests – Within 3 business days
* Priority Requests – Within 1 business day
* Monitor request queues, maintain tracking logs, and provide regular updates to stakeholders.
* Analyze request patterns and identify opportunities to automate repetitive activities and enhance self-service capabilities.
* Develop and maintain reusable reports, dashboards, and data assets to support business development and leadership requirements.

**Stakeholder & User Management**

* Act as a key point of contact for CRM-related data queries and support requests from Partners, Directors, and business teams.
* Support onboarding and offboarding of CRM users, ensuring appropriate role-based access and security controls.
* Collaborate with the Digital Office and relevant teams on data migration activities, system enhancements, configuration updates, and process improvements.
* Conduct user awareness sessions and promote adherence to CRM data governance standards and best practices.

**Reporting & Continuous Improvement**

* Prepare periodic dashboards and reports on data quality metrics, request turnaround times, compliance levels, and governance KPIs.
* Support the CRM Governance Lead in implementing data quality initiatives and governance frameworks.
* Identify process inefficiencies and drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance operational effectiveness and user experience.
* Participate in CRM enhancement projects and contribute to the evolution of data governance capabilities within the firm.

**Qualifications, Experience & Skills**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Commerce, Information Systems, Analytics, or a related field.
* 4–6 years of experience in CRM Operations, Data Management, Data Governance, or CRM Administration.
* Hands-on experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 (preferred) or similar CRM platforms.
* Strong understanding of CRM data management, data quality, and Master Data Management (MDM) principles.
* Advanced Excel skills and working knowledge of Power BI.
* Experience in data cleansing, de-duplication, reporting, and maintaining data integrity across large datasets.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills.
* Detail-oriented, process-driven, and committed to data accuracy and governance.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver within defined SLAs.
* Excellent communication skills and a strong sense of ownership and accountability.

You will create the systems, pipelines and automation needed to ingest, normalise, validate and deliver very large volumes of proprietary and alternative data across HFT, ETFs, options, indices, ecommerce, contracts and M&A.

This is a high-impact, hands-on leadership role. You will work directly with traders, quantitative researchers, engineers and business stakeholders to turn fragmented, complex and often unstructured data into reliable, low-latency, research-ready and trading-ready datasets.

You will combine strong data engineering with automation, Python development and practical use of LLMs and AI agents to accelerate ingestion, extraction, enrichment, classification and data-quality workflows.

**What You’ll Do**

* Define and deliver the technical architecture for a firm-wide proprietary data platform, covering ingestion, storage, transformation, cataloguing, lineage, access and delivery.
* Build high-volume, high-reliability batch and near-real-time data pipelines for market, reference, alternative and proprietary datasets.
* Design pipelines and data models for HFT-related data, including market data, order data, execution data, ETF, options and index data.
* Build data ingestion and enrichment systems for ecommerce, corporate contracts, M&A, filings, news and other unstructured or semi-structured sources.
* Work closely with traders and quants to understand research, alpha, risk, execution and trading-workflow requirements, then translate them into scalable data products.
* Build automated ingestion, parsing, normalisation, deduplication, validation and reconciliation frameworks.
* Develop production-grade Python services, tooling and pipeline components for data extraction, transformation, orchestration and quality control.
* Apply LLMs, embeddings and AI-agent workflows to extract structured information from documents, contracts, filings, web content and other unstructured sources.
* Build automated data-quality, anomaly-detection and lineage frameworks to ensure datasets
* Mentor data engineers and collaborate with infrastructure, quant, trading and software engineering teams.
* Stay hands-on: write code, debug complex pipeline issues, review designs and drive technical decisions.

**What We’re Looking For**

* Significant experience as a Principal, Staff, Lead or Senior Data Engineer, ideally within a trading firm, hedge fund, market maker, fintech or data-intensive technology business.
* Expert-level Python, with a track record of building clean, performant, production-grade data engineering systems.
* Deep experience designing and operating large-scale ETL/ELT pipelines across multiple internal and external data sources.
* Strong SQL and data-modelling skills, with experience across relational, columnar and/or NoSQL databases.
* Experience building data platforms or critical data infrastructure from scratch, rather than only maintaining existing systems.
* Strong understanding of data quality, reconciliation, lineage, metadata, schema evolution and automated validation.
* Experience processing structured, semi-structured and unstructured data, including APIs, files, web data, documents and event streams.
* Practical experience using LLMs or AI/ML techniques for extraction, classification, enrichment, search or workflow automation.

**Desirable Experience**

* Direct experience with financial datasets, including equities, ETFs, options, futures, indices, market data, reference data or alternative data.
* Exposure to HFT, electronic trading, execution, order-book or market-microstructure data.
* Experience with low-latency or high-throughput data systems.

description:
**Hiring: SAP Data Migration Consultant – S/4HANA Finance & Alteryx**

**Industry:**
IT Services & Consulting

**Experience:**
5–8 Years

**Budget:**
Up to ₹25 LPA

**Work Mode:**
Hybrid
